newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Princess Cristina to wed on October 4.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Princess Cristina to wed on October 4.

text.p: Spain's royal palace announced on Tuesday that the wedding of Princess Cristina to Olympic handball player Inaki Urdangarin would take place on October 4.

The announcement did not specify where the marriage ceremony of King Juan Carlos and Queen Sofia's younger daughter would be held but it has previously said it would be in Barcelona, where the couple live and work.

Cristina, 31, is third in line to the throne after her unmarried younger brother, Crown Prince Felipe, and her elder sister Elena, who married in a glittering ceremony in the southern city of Seville two years ago.

The Spanish public has a deep affection and respect for the unpretentious royal family and has a special regard for the king's role in helping to guide Spain to democratic rule after the death of dictator Francisco Franco in 1975.
